rows.label: tlk43310148_01_msg0001
rows.name: A Driver and a Blade, huh...

rows.label: tlk43310148_01_msg0003
rows.name:
A Driver's traits change depending on
the weapons wielded by the Blades
traveling alongside.

rows.label: tlk43310148_01_msg0004
rows.name:
If you've got, say, two with
Megalances by your side, that gives
you the class of Elite Fighter.

rows.label: tlk43310148_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Or if you've got one with a
Ball and one with a Hammer,
then you're a Knight.

rows.label: tlk43310148_01_msg0006
rows.name:
A good Driver tries out all kinds
of different combinations and figures
out what works best with what.
